title: 30 By ANT
description: This dataset comprises electroencephalography (EEG) recordings from participants undergoing nociceptive laser stimulation with concurrent pain ratings. Thirty laser stimuli of individually calibrated intensity were delivered to each participant, who provided verbal pain intensity ratings on a 0-10 scale. The study investigates the neural correlates of pain perception and subjective pain rating behavior during controlled nociceptive stimulation.
methods_description: Participants received 30 laser stimulations at individually calibrated intensity levels (corresponding to an average pain rating of 7). Following each stimulus, participants provided verbal pain ratings on a scale from 0 (no sensation) to 10 (unbearable pain). Participants were instructed to maintain fixation on a crosshair while keeping eyes open. A 5-second inter-stimulus interval separated each trial, with subsequent trials beginning at random intervals after pain rating completion. Laser markers in the EEG data are delayed by 100ms.
